question:
The given letter clusters follow a certain pattern. Select the option that gives the correct sequence of the letters that are missing from the letter clusters.

DECAB / GJFF_ / KNJJ_ / PQOM_
solution:
​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f9d84d59fc86f5fda202643135d08de431306e7e61f6a93d03bb57bb4e3d7ef.png] 

 
• The pattern followed here is:
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abacee82ac0345ca0134d94827eddbba3035f518b0bebb5fd11cef00cda03670.png] 

 
• Here, 'EIN' gives the correct sequence of the letters that are missing from the letter clusters.

Hence, EIN is the correct answer.
